items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the poem 'Childhood', and answer.

"Riya remembered the evening she discovered that the old banyan tree was not haunted. For years she had run past it, heart thumping. Then her science teacher explained the rustling sound – bats settling for the night. She stood under it alone the next day, half disappointed, half proud. Something had ended, she felt, and something else had begun."

Answer the following:
(i) Why had Riya always run past the banyan tree?  (a) It was a shortcut  (b) She believed it was haunted  (c) It was very hot  (d) Dogs lived there
(ii) Which discovery in "Childhood" does this resemble?
(iii) What had "ended" for Riya?  (a) Her innocent childhood belief  (b) Her holiday  (c) Her school year  (d) Her friendship
(iv) Find a word in the passage that means "beating fast".  (a) thumping  (b) rustling  (c) running  (d) settling
items.answer: (i) (b) She believed it was haunted (ii) That Hell and Heaven cannot be found in geography – reason replacing belief. (iii) (a) Her innocent childhood belief (iv) (a) thumping
items.markingKey: (i) (b) She believed it was haunted (ii) That Hell and Heaven cannot be found in geography – reason replacing belief. (iii) (a) Her innocent childhood belief (iv) (a) thumping (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
